focus: Answer persistence, energy levels and the just-do-it path across sk-prompt, Interactive Mode, Flow Mode and the kernel
answeredQuestions: How should intake answers persist across turns, and what changes when the user says just do it or selects Quick energy?
noveltyJustification: Twelve findings; four are new (sk-prompt rounds, sk-prompt never-ask path, the missing record home, the Brief block), and the rest deepen iteration 1 and 3 findings with exact contract lines.
ruledOut: Reusing the clarification export file as the intake record
Putting the brief on the board as a sticky or section

label: sk-prompt scales internal rounds by energy (10 text, 3 short, 0 raw), the in-repo precedent for an energy-selected round cap.
sk-prompt has a non-interactive path that never asks: it proceeds on stated assumptions and flags each one, the exact shape a just-do-it path needs.
sk-prompt escalates below a stated 50 percent confidence, which shows a numeric threshold is in keeping with the house style though it scores intent, not understanding.
Just-do-it vocabulary already exists: no-questions language selects Quick, and skip-depth is the only route to Raw, so the loop needs a rule per energy level rather than a new command.
Quick may skip routine intake, and the facts it may never skip are Doc-shaped, leaving the reader and the board's message unprotected at Quick energy.
Flow Mode already refuses to let Quick skip the check, gate and read-back, so Quick may skip intake rounds but never the final confirmation.
The clarification export may hold only the question, and Flow Mode saves nothing at all, so intake answers have no durable home today.
The kernel cannot write files, so a Project-side intake record can only be the conversation and a re-rendered reply, never a Knowledge write.
Parts of the record exist for one turn only: the provenance table, the Left out line and the userIntent sentence are never replayed as confirmed brief facts.
Public practice treats a decisions summary with confidence beside each decision as part of the deliverable, and the Flow reply has no equivalent recap.
Inference: energy maps to rounds - Quick draws after one confirmation of proposed facts, Standard stops at three rounds, Deep adds alternative framings and a sketch at five.
Inference: the durable record is a Brief block in the working model, replayed each round and carried into the gate, never a board node that would need its own yes.
